question: Which of the following is NOT an Indian tournament?
solution:
The correct answer is __**UEFA Champions League**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **UEFA Champions League** is a European football tournament.
 
• It is organized by the **Union of European Football Associations (UEFA)**.
 
• The competition is contested by top-division European clubs.
 
• It is one of the most prestigious tournaments in the world and the most prestigious club competition in European football.
 
• The tournament was first established in **1955**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Durand Cup** is the oldest football tournament in India, first held in 1888.
 
• The **Santosh Trophy** is an annual Indian football tournament which started in 1941.
 
• The **Subroto Cup** is an inter-school football tournament in India, named after Indian Air Force Air Marshal Subroto Mukerjee.
